title: Worship in Daily Life
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Worship in daily life means offering the whole person to God in reverence, gratitude, obedience, and love. Worship is not limited to songs or gatherings, but includes all of life lived before the Lord.
summary: Worship in daily life means offering the whole person to God in reverence, gratitude, obedience, and love. Worship is not limited to songs or gatherings, but includes all of life lived before the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes true worship possible by bringing believers to the Father. Through Him, God’s people worship in Spirit and truth and offer lives that honor His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Worship is bigger than a service or song. Scripture calls believers to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God. This means daily life belongs to Him.

Everything done in word or deed is to be done in the name of the Lord Jesus. Work, relationships, speech, service, rest, generosity, and obedience can become acts of worship when offered to God by faith.

True worship is shaped by Spirit and truth. It is not merely emotion, style, or outward form. God is honored by hearts and lives surrendered to Him through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people divide life into spiritual and ordinary categories, as though worship happens only at church. This makes discipleship small and leaves daily habits untouched.

This doctrine teaches believers that all of life is lived before God. The kitchen, workplace, hospital room, classroom, wheelchair, recovery meeting, and quiet home can all become places of worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Offer today to God. Sing and pray, but also worship through obedience, gratitude, speech, service, generosity, endurance, and love. Ask whether your ordinary actions are being done in the name of Christ and for the glory of God.
